text: Mobile app development involves creating software for smartphones and tablets. A key part of this process is responsive design, which ensures that an app works well on different screen sizes and devices. Developers must also decide between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one specific platform and often perform better, while cross-platform apps can run on both iOS and Android, saving time and money. After development, apps are usually published on app stores like Google Play or the App Store. However, performance remains a major concern, as users expect fast, smooth, and reliable applications.
